answer: Commit-reveal bond: each identity locks a 60-credit bond and files a hash of its pigment-marked dawn plan. At close it reveals the signed work; the auditor recomputes the hash, and the pigment stamps echo the plan. A mismatch burns the bond; bought reveals fail the key check. Each fake needs a fresh proof: first 100, k-th 100+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,597,500 plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once and reclaim it.
